shared.instructions:
Identify the computer where commands will run before acting. In Herdr, Local means the computer running the client. A workspace on the other machine runs commands there. Use the full Tailscale MagicDNS name for automated connections.

For repeatable work, prefer an installed CLI with machine-readable output when it covers the task. Use the chrome-toolkit skill to choose Playwright CLI for browser automation and Chrome DevTools CLI for deep diagnostics. Use MCP when it provides needed capabilities or authenticated access.

The dotfiles checkout is normally at ~/repos/dotfiles. Read its AGENTS.md before working there. Use dot ai status to inspect managed Codex settings. Edit a personal managed skill at its tracked source in config/ai-customization/skills, then validate and publish it through dotfiles. Keep private details and credentials in local files.

kubuntu-desktop.instructions: This is the Kubuntu desktop. The other Herdr machine is the IdeaPad laptop.

kubuntu-laptop.instructions: This is the Kubuntu IdeaPad. The other Herdr machine is the desktop.
